name: Luxury coach
bags: One case per seat, in the hold
short: A full-size coach for large groups, conferences and wedding guests.
summary: A full-size touring coach for large groups, conference delegates and wedding guests arriving together.

features.title: Arrivals in one move
features.body: Meet a flight's worth of wedding guests at the airport and bring them to the hotel together, with the luggage in the hold.

features.title: Comfort for long transfers
features.body: Reclining seats, air conditioning and a microphone for the guide on transfers of three hours or more.

features.title: Several coaches, one plan
features.body: For the largest groups we run a small fleet with one coordinator, so every coach leaves on time and nobody is left behind.

included: Driver's meals and rooms on multi-day hires

questions.q: How many coaches do we need for 120 wedding guests?
questions.a: Usually three, timed to the main flights. Send us the arrival list when you have it and we will plan the runs.

questions.q: Can a coach go anywhere a car can?
questions.a: No. Large coaches stay on the main roads, so some villas and estates need a transfer in smaller vehicles for the last stretch. We plan that for you.
